> Profile · Alphalete · 2026-10-01

Also drawn from: `CLAUDE.md` in the same folder

# Summary
The Company Avatar (13 pages, "Company Master Profile as of October 1, 2026") is the single source of truth for anyone writing, ranking or selling for Alphalete. Every fact is tagged Verified, Client-stated, Unconfirmed or Do not use. This note keeps the parts that matter day to day.

# Basics
- **Name:** Alphalete Trenchless Services (site, logo, trucks). GBP name is "Alphalete Trenchless Sewer & Drain Rehabilitation"; schema uses the GBP name with "Alphalete Trenchless Services" as alternate. Alphalete Mechanical LLC appears as the license holder (unconfirmed).
- **Sister company:** Alphalete Plumbing (same suite, about 300 reviews vs about 16). Keep the brands distinct in all copy and listings.
- **Site:** https://alphaletetrenchless.com (WordPress, pixfort Essentials theme + Elementor, Hostinger, LiteSpeed + Hostinger CDN).
- **Office (NAP address):** 716 Clark Pl, Ste 160, Colorado Springs, CO 80915. Email team@alphaletetrenchless.com.
- **Phone:** no single official number yet. The site displays (719) 787-7746 (WhatConverts tracking), schema lists (719) 650-2273, the Search Atlas knowledge graph lists (720) 807-3224. Never type a number into page copy; link to Contact.
- **Hours:** GBP says open 24 hours (unconfirmed). Do not claim 24/7 or emergency service.
- **Years in business:** unknown. Do not state a number.

# Services
- Five service pages: Residential Trenchless Pipelining (CIPP), Commercial Trenchless Pipelining, Sewer Camera Inspection, Hydro Jetting, Drain Cleaning.
- Methods, not services: CIPP relining, sectional point repair. Pipe bursting as a service is unconfirmed.
- Priority: residential CIPP / no-dig repair (every Ads conversion in the 12 months before June 2026 came from Residential CIPP), camera inspection as the lead hook, then commercial and municipal.
- Never imply: home inspection, mold/spore detection, gas line, faucet/toilet/water heater work, directional drilling, repiping.
- Equipment: HammerHead Bluelight LED curing (client-stated), HD camera, hydro jetting rigs.

# Customers and triggers
Homeowners with older clay, cast iron or Orangeburg laterals; home buyers needing a scope; commercial property managers, HOAs, school districts and municipal owners. Triggers: backups, failed scope at a sale, repeat clogs, monsoon storm backups, an excavation quote they want to avoid.

# Brand and voice
- Navy #1A1B5E, orange #F06F23 / #E57300; Oswald headings, Montserrat body. Real no-dig field imagery, never digging scenes.
- Honest, expert, local, calm. Answer the question in the first sentence.
- Avoid: cheapest, best, #1, guaranteed, lifetime, 24/7, same-day, "free" (until cleared), dollar amounts, "50 years", em dashes.
- 20-year warranty is client-stated but its wording must be cleared by the Agency owner. "50+ year" lifespan is Do not use.

# Geography
Primary city Colorado Springs (El Paso County); secondary metros Denver, Pueblo, Castle Rock, Parker, Littleton, Lone Tree, Monument, Fountain, Canon City, Woodland Park, Security-Widefield. 44 root city pages are live. True service radius is unconfirmed (the GBP's statewide area is wrong). Verified local themes: expansive bentonite clay, freeze-thaw and about 36-inch frost depth, July to August monsoon backups, 1950s to 1970s clay/cast iron laterals, owner responsibility for the service line.

# SEO identity (keyword owners)
Homepage owns "trenchless sewer repair"; `/services/` owns "trenchless pipe repair"; residential page retargets to CIPP / no-dig; commercial hub owns "commercial sewer line repair"; `/colorado-springs/` and `/denver/` own the city sewer repair terms. Section 13 lists 23 AEO questions to use as the FAQ bank.

# Competitors seen in data
Alphalete Plumbing (sister, outranks on maps), simplysewersdenver.com (Denver organic), nuflow.com (AI citations), Denver Ads brands (added as negatives), HomeAdvisor/Angi (cost queries).

# Open items (from the profile)
- Official phone, real hours, legal name, warranty wording, "free" inspection wording.
- Job value, margins, demographics and years in business are all unknown.
